messages.text:
The backend and build are passing; the browser smoke check exposed one mobile accessibility/detail issue: the off-canvas sidebar links are still targetable while visually closed.

I’m making the closed drawer inert on mobile and adding a visible analytics dock entry so the mobile user flow has a reachable route.
